the PDGF receptors are expressed on the thyroid epithelial cells in the undifferentiated anaplastic thyroid cancer.

TSH and PDGFA receptors can be coexpressed and function in human anaplastic carcinoma cells.

the HTh 72 and HTh 74 cell lines represent anaplastic thyroid cancer cell lines with the ability to express functional receptors for both TSH and plate-let-derived growth factor.
